**Finding: LD — compliant (preferred position met).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-exit fee exists anywhere in the Agreement:

- **Termination (§14, p0079):** Client may elect to terminate; services and fees simply run to the last day of the following month. No fee or stipulated sum attaches.
- **Term/non-renewal (§13, p0078):** 30 days' notice of intent not to renew, with no exit payment.
- **Compensation (§5, p0045; §6, p0047):** The minimum monthly amounts ("but not less than $____ per month") are consideration for services provided during the term, not a sum payable on termination or breach. Exhibits A and B are charge schedules only.
- **Liability (p0077):** The only cap runs against TrueLink; nothing creates a Client-payable stipulated amount. Section 7 (spamming) carries no per-message charge — only §8f technical-blocking and general legal/equitable remedies.

Because service credits/LDs running to us are welcome and nothing runs against us, there is no fallback (3-month cap) to negotiate and no redline proposed. Two non-LD notes flagged in the rationale for the fee negotiation only: the blank minimum monthly figures, and the §6 bar on contesting "minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4" (an apparent mis-citation to Section 5).
